problem: The shape unconditionally requires environmental functionality measures to be true for every ship, although the requirement limits these measures to cases where low-temperature, topside-icing, and sea-ice functionality measures are applicable.
required_change: Make this obligation conditional on the relevant applicability condition, or otherwise permit the property to be absent or not required when those measures are not applicable.
regression_guard: Preserve the requirement that applicable environmental functionality measures are covered.

problem: The required procedure fields accept an empty xsd:string, so a ship can satisfy minCount without supplying any procedure content.
required_change: Require non-empty string values for each procedure field, for example by adding sh:minLength 1 while retaining the existing mandatory cardinality and datatype.
regression_guard: Preserve all four mandatory procedure coverage fields and their xsd:string datatypes.
